item.title: 【環境】 Photocatalytic nitrogen reduction to high-concentration ammonia via interfacial evaporation
item.description: Synthesis of valuable ammonia through photocatalytic reduction of nitrogen is a promising sustainable route, but its efficiency remains limited. This work shows that coupling the reaction with solar-driven interfacial evaporation can substantially improve ammonia yield, concentration and purity.
